svg.title: Ichor Skyship — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A brass-and-copper flying ship based on the supplied references, with a boat hull, two cream sails, fins, cyan engine window, and rear propeller. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
